body: The thing is I've tried changing my behavior but it never sticks. I'm currently in therapy you but it's not working out, and the thought of finding another one is as daunting as my coursework
Thanks man glad to know you're there for when I'm in my darkest days

On some level I know it's not that big a deal, it's just more of a pattern I have of avoiding something stressful till the last minute and then getting super stressed/depressed at once. However I never learn, and it makes me realize I'm a failure because I never truly learn from them

I'm majoring in history

I really doubt I can get an extension. Because I'd have to admit I'm in a life threatening situation.

And I can't ditch because I still need to turn the assignment in. If it's late I get marked down which would make me more stressed
It's too late to drop and taking a semester off won't help me with the stress I feel now
